prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, soft and heavy and slack; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, her waist lost beneath the folds, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly teal hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin glossy crimson PVC with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to just under her bust, the two sides of the PVC fully covering her bust, a wide horizontal band cut away across her ribs and stomach from just under her bust down to below her navel, the whole band bare, with two thin vertical straps of the PVC at the sides joining the bust section to the skirt, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin PVC molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the two thin side straps holding the bust section above the open band, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, fine pull-creases and a deep mirror shine. Pose: sitting on the top of the giant cork with both legs hanging over the side crossed at the ankles, one hand resting on it beside her hip and the other hand resting on her thigh, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy crimson PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy crimson PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a party table in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic champagne cork with its gold foil and wire cage beside a giant green bottle, giant shiny confetti pieces and curled ribbons scattered around, giant gold balloons floating behind, a softly blurred party hall far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on top of the giant cork with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm festive light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous champagne cork, confetti and balloons around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly visible dangling in the air. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
